newsitem.title: FRANCE: French rate cuts due Ffr confidence,policy-Trichet.
newsitem.headline: French rate cuts due Ffr confidence,policy-Trichet.

text.p: PARIS, Dec 17 (REUTER) - Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday that interest rate cuts in France had been made possible by confidence in the franc and in government policies.

"This decline in interest rates which began in October 1995 corresponds to a considerable increase in confidence in the French franc and in the creditworthiness of France in connection with the policies set forth by the President of the Republic and the government for a reduction of government deficits, the stability of the franc and monetary union in 1999," Trichet told a news conference.
